title: Yellow Grassy Korean Duck Bokkeum
description: A romantic Korean dish from Busan featuring duck sauce and infused oil, wrapped in a corn husk, this ovo-vegetarian friendly bokkeum is a unique experience, with grassy and gooey textures combining for a delightful meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the duck sauce and infused oil.
Add the sliced zucchini, carrots, and chopped green onions to the bowl and toss to coat.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss gently to combine.
Season the mixture with sesame seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Lay a corn husk flat on a work surface and spoon about 1/2 cup of the mixture onto the center of the husk.
Fold the sides of the husk over the filling and roll up the husk to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining corn husks and filling.
Place the filled corn husks seam side down in a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Serve the bokkeum hot, garnished with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
